claim.text: At 2.72 s the struck vehicle entered the ego lane, creating the hazard.
Perception took 0.22 s from hazard onset to first detection, below the 0.30 s threshold.
The system handed off 4.05 s after first detection, at 7.00 s.
Only 1.00 s remained from handoff to impact, below the 1.50 s human response allowance.
The first CAN brake request was at 8.30 s, 0.30 s after the 8.00 s impact.
Brake actuation took 0.32 s from request to pressure, below the 0.45 s threshold.
With nominal perception 0.20 s, command 0.05 s and brake tau 0.35 s, the counterfactual avoided contact with a 43.305 m minimum gap.
The witness said the other vehicle had no turn signal during its lane change, and an independent recheck confirmed the same observation.
